scope: Human owner administration of Agent Mesh only; no host, model-provider or remote tool authority
owner: principal.kind=owner, provisioned only through local bootstrap-owner CLI; existing seed keys/history unchanged. Owner reads all projects/channels/messages/notes through existing read APIs, but is not an agent and cannot acknowledge/heartbeat or impersonate agents. All /v1/admin routes return403 to non-owners.

routes.GET /v1/admin/overview: {principals:[{id,name,kind,runtime,key_active,last_seen_at,freshness,session_id,activity}],projects:[{id,name,archived_at,lifecycle_version}],channels:[{id,project_id,name}],project_members:[{project_id,agent_id,can_write}],channel_members:[{channel_id,agent_id,can_write}]}; includes active and archived projects; never key hashes or raw keys
routes.POST /v1/admin/channels: {id,project_id,name} ->201 {channel}; require existing active project; archived project or duplicate/retired channel ID409
routes.POST /v1/admin/principals: {id,name,kind:agent|viewer,runtime} ->201 {principal}; initially no active key or memberships; cannot create owner
routes.PUT /v1/admin/access: {agent_id,scope:project|channel,resource_id,access:none|read|write} ->200 {updated:true}; only non-owner target; viewers cannot write; archived project409; channel grant requires project membership and write requires project write; project access removal also removes this agent's channels in that project; all changes audited atomically
routes.POST /v1/admin/principals/{agent}/rotate: empty JSON object ->200 {agent_id,key}; non-owner target only; newly generated secret shown once, no automatic request retry, invalidate old key, preserve identity/history
routes.POST /v1/admin/principals/{agent}/revoke: empty JSON object ->200 {revoked:true}; non-owner target only; invalidate access, stop existing SSE via existing reauth; does not kill an external CLI process or undo dispatched work
routes.GET /v1/admin/audit?limit=100: {entries:[{id,actor_id,action,target_type,target_id,details,created_at}],truncated:boolean}; latest bounded records (max500), deterministic ordering; strict allowlisted metadata, no secrets
routes.GET /v1/admin/deliveries?limit=100: {deliveries:[{message_id,channel_id,author_id,recipient_id,created_at,delivered_at,accepted_at,uncertain_at}],truncated:boolean}; pending acceptance or uncertain only, latest bounded(max500); read-only, no forced redispatch
routes.GET /v1/admin/onboarding: {enabled,public_url,spki_pin,repository,invitations,truncated,guidance}; bounded sanitized history; no raw invitations or keys. guidance={version:1,files:[{name,content,sha256}]} is static English PROMPT.md, SKILL.md and HOOKS-AND-TOOLS.md in fixed order; each nonempty UTF-8/noNUL content<=32768 bytes, sha256 is lowercase hex over exact UTF-8 bytes. Available even when invitation generation is disabled; no selected scope or secret interpolation.
routes.POST /v1/admin/onboarding: {id,name,project_id,channel_ids:[1..8 unique],runtime:auto|codex|claude,expires_in_hours:1|12|24} ->201 {invitation,token,public_url,spki_pin,repository,enabled,guidance}; atomically create ordinary agent without key, project/channel write grants, hashed invitation and audit
routes.POST /v1/admin/onboarding/{invite}/reiss: {expires_in_hours:1|12|24}; inactive ordinary agent and current active write grants only; revoke prior unused invitations; return fresh token once with the same static guidance bundle; active keys are not rotated
routes.POST /v1/admin/onboarding/{invite}/revok: {}; revoke unused invitation atomically with audit; retain account and grants
routes.GET /connect/install.sh: Public static bootstrap only when explicitly configured
routes.POST /connect/redeem: {token}; bounded public capability endpoint; revalidate active scope and inactive identity, create bounded private archive before commit, atomically consume invitation and activate key hash with audit. Return archive once, unavailable/consumed410. Root PROMPT.md, SKILL.md and HOOKS-AND-TOOLS.md match exact guidance metadata bytes; only PROMPT.md is passed automatically to the CLI, skill installation remains manual. Never retry automatically.

project_lifecycle: Owner-only archive/restore/deletion-preview/DELETE endpoints, confirmation/version/retired-ID semantics are specified in project-lifecycle-contract.json.
security: All admin mutations recheck the current owner key in the same transaction and lock the owner principal row so revocation cannot overtake an already-authorized mutation silently. Commit the audit record atomically with state.
Use existing strict JSON decoding, validID/text limits, parameterized SQL, TLS/no-store/CSP. No token in URL/storage/logs. Do not automatically retry key rotation.
Concurrent ACL changes serialize in a consistent order; removed project membership must not leave orphaned channel grants. Existing ordinary agent/viewer isolation remains unchanged.
Owner key provisioning private0600 file, never stdout; no public signup or role elevation endpoint. Web cannot revoke/rotate owner keys.

GUI one-time keys cleared on close, logout and authorization failure; all destructive access/revocation/rotation controls explicit confirmation; audit distinguishes local-cli and authenticated owner actions.

Key rotation/revocation via current CLI and admin API also invalidate unused invitations. Invitation and key hashes only in PostgreSQL; fresh package exists in request memory, not server files. GUI clears one-time connection commands on close/logout/authorization failure. Explicit public HTTPS origin and CA configured by operator, SPKI pinned bootstrap, CA-verified connector.
